critique.evidence: Strong, cohesive cyber-forensic art direction: disciplined near-black palette, cyan/red semantic accents, crisp borders, and clear verified-versus-mismatch hierarchy. Tablet and mobile reflow the evidence chain cleanly. It misses demo-ready polish because the desktop headline is disproportionately dominant, leaving an awkward floating explainer and large dead zones; several labels and annotations are extremely small and low-contrast; the mobile chart is nearly illegible; and the global header feels cramped, with clipped/partially visible navigation and distracting oversized background lettering on desktop. Contrast verification is also incomplete for 3 tablet and 13 mobile header nodes.
critique.fix: Rebalance the desktop hero into a tighter grid, enlarge chart and annotation text, increase muted-text contrast, and give the mobile visualization enough height to remain readable. Refine the header with a deliberate compact-nav treatment, clearer active state, stronger edge affordance for horizontal navigation, and remove or contain the clipped background wordmark.
